description: One self-contained Node CLI module (no imports, no bundler) obfuscated by the `afterpack` CLI over a dist/ holding EXACTLY ONE .js file. Every other CLI fixture (vanilla-esm, requirejs-amd) points the pass at a multi-file tree, so the single-file shape -- the one per-file CLI directive capture will be built on -- had no coverage. No browser surface: the proof is that the obfuscated program still RUNS under node, so `smoke` is deliberately absent and cli-single-file.spec.ts asserts on stdout/exit codes instead.

build.note: build.mjs copies src/cli.js -> dist/cli.js then runs `afterpack ./dist --seed=<seed> --build.backup=false`; honors AFTERPACK_build_autorun=false for the un-obfuscated baseline

cases.description: sum runs the #private-field Ledger class and serializes it
describe defaults its optional positional and reports argc
an unknown command still fails closed with exit 1 + usage on stderr
a non-numeric operand still fails closed with exit 1
